scope: reviewed low-stakes learning, worksheet and toolkit-card surfaces

findings.evidence: The existing crawl-graph gate already requires every sitemap URL to have inbound indexed links and remain within depth three; the new layer adds only sitemap-backed continuation targets.
Continuation links use task-specific labels and resource titles rather than generic click-here anchors.
scripts/check_crawl_graph.py preserves no-orphan and homepage-depth requirements separately from contextual continuation.
The rollout reuses reviewed Learn, Worksheet and Toolkit relationships plus the existing practice relation model; it does not infer clinical personalization.
Reviewed learning surfaces already expose visible breadcrumbs and BreadcrumbList where applicable; this rollout preserves rather than replaces them.
A curated Continue from here block connects explanation to worksheet or related reviewed card only where the relationship is explicitly maintained.
Reviewed target pages expose browser-local Save plus Share, Copy link and Cite actions using the canonical page URL.
The Cite utility copies project name, page title and canonical URL without inventing authorship, DOI, clinical status or publication dates.
No Preferred Sources control is added until current source-preference availability and publisher applicability are verified independently.
Deterministic final checks reject missing utilities, missing continuation, non-indexed targets and accidental noindex; a bounded post-deploy check verifies representative live pages.
